h1. rotate_password  -  Sequence Diagram

{info}
Child page of: *rotate_password  -  Ansible Role Reference*
{info}

----

{code:language=mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant PB as Playbook (Phase 2)
    participant Vault as HashiCorp Vault
    participant ExaCC as ExaCC Node
    participant Oracle as Oracle DB (sqlplus)
    participant DG as DG Standby Nodes

    Note right of PB: Phase 1 - Vault Pre-check
    PB->>Vault: GET /role/vault_role_name
    Vault-->>PB: created_at, current_version (baseline)
    PB->>PB: Assert password present, age >= min_age_days

    Note right of PB: Phase 2 - Topology Detection
    PB->>ExaCC: dbaascli database getDetails --dbname
    ExaCC-->>PB: dbRole, SCAN, PDB list, topology flags
    PB->>PB: Set db_role, dg_detected, commvault_detected

    Note right of PB: Phase 3 - Oracle Pre-check
    ExaCC->>Oracle: CONNECT target_user/PASS as sysdba (SYS) or CONNECT user/PASS
    Oracle-->>ExaCC: CREDENTIAL_OK
    PB->>Oracle: SELECT from dba_users WHERE username = target_user
    Oracle-->>PB: account_status, expiry_date, account_profile
    PB->>PB: Assert db_role == PRIMARY, account not LOCKED

    opt dg_detected == true
        Note right of PB: Phase 4 - Data Guard Pre-check
        PB->>Oracle: SELECT lag from v$dataguard_stats
        PB->>PB: Assert lag <= dg_max_lag_seconds, no gap sequences
    end

    Note right of PB: Phase 5 - Password Policy
    PB->>Oracle: SELECT from dba_profiles WHERE profile = account_profile
    Oracle-->>PB: PASSWORD_ROLLOVER_TIME and limits
    PB->>PB: Assert PASSWORD_ROLLOVER_TIME >= min_rollover_time_days

    Note right of PB: Phase 6 - Session and RMAN Gate
    PB->>Oracle: SELECT from gv$session WHERE username = target_user
    Oracle-->>PB: Active session count
    PB->>Oracle: SELECT from v$rman_backup_job_details WHERE status = RUNNING
    Oracle-->>PB: RMAN job count (fail if > 0)

    Note right of PB: Phase 7 - Evaluate Rotation
    PB->>PB: Compare secret_age_days vs password_max_age_days
    alt rotation_required == true
        PB->>ExaCC: Write break-glass file (chmod 0600, root-owned)
    end

    opt rotation_required == true
        Note right of PB: Phase 8 - Rotate
        alt dg_detected and target_user == SYS
            PB->>ExaCC: dbaascli changePassword --user SYS --prepareStandbyBlob
        else non-DG or non-SYS
            PB->>ExaCC: dbaascli changePassword --user target_user
        end
        PB->>Vault: POST /role/vault_role_name with new credential
        Vault-->>PB: 200 OK

        opt dg_detected == true
            Note right of PB: Phase 9 - Data Guard Propagation
            alt target_user == SYS
                PB->>ExaCC: SCP blob to each standby
                loop Each standby
                    PB->>DG: dbaascli changePassword --standbyBlobFromPrimary
                end
                PB->>ExaCC: Delete blob (primary + all standbys)
            else non-SYS
                loop Each standby
                    PB->>DG: dbaascli changePassword --user target_user
                end
            end
            loop Each standby role
                PB->>Vault: POST /role/target_user_standby_EXACC
                Vault-->>PB: 200 OK
            end
        end

        Note right of PB: Phase 11 - Post-Validation
        PB->>Oracle: CONNECT target_user/new_cred as sysdba (SYS) or CONNECT user/new_cred
        Oracle-->>PB: CONNECTION_OK, account_status not LOCKED
        PB->>Vault: GET /role/vault_role_name
        Vault-->>PB: current_version > pre-rotation baseline
        PB->>ExaCC: Delete break-glass backup file
    end

    Note right of PB: Phase 12 - Record Result
    PB->>PB: set_fact rotation_summary -> localhost (ROTATED or SKIPPED)
{code}

{note:title=Mermaid Plugin Required}
The diagram above requires the *Mermaid Diagrams for Confluence* app (Atlassian Marketplace). If the plugin is not installed the diagram will render as a syntax-highlighted code block.
{note}
